class.name: Vector2RollingAverage
class.brief_description: A rolling/moving average for Vector2 values.
class.description: This class maintains a rolling average of Vector2 values, updating the average as new values are added. It is useful for smoothing out noisy data or creating a moving average of a sequence of values. It requires that you specify the window size when creating an instance of the class and will start with a default average of (0, 0).

method.name: populate
method.description: Populates the rolling average with an array of Vector2 values. Make sure the packed array size matches the window size. This will recalculate the average using the provided values.

method.name: set_window_size
method.description: Sets the window size for the rolling average. This determines how many values are used to calculate the average. Required before adding any values.

method.name: update
method.description: Updates the rolling average with a new Vector2 value. The average will be recalculated based on the new value and the existing values in the window.
